questions.question: What magazine publishes Harry's interview about Voldemort's return?
questions.note: Luna's father, Xenophilius Lovegood, runs it. The Prophet is still calling Harry a liar.

questions.question: What house is Luna Lovegood in?
questions.note: She can see thestrals, she joins the D.A., and she believes Harry when most of the school does not.

questions.question: How do Fred and George leave Hogwarts for good?
questions.answer: On brooms, in a burst of fireworks
choices: On brooms, in a burst of fireworks
By Portkey from the head's office
questions.note: Fireworks fill the corridors. They fly out over the grounds and do not come back.

questions.question: Who carries Umbridge off into the Forbidden Forest?
questions.note: Hermione leads her there. Umbridge insults the centaurs, and they take her.

questions.question: Which Death Eater tortured Neville Longbottom's parents into insanity?
questions.note: Neville says so when he sees her in the Department of Mysteries. The Cruciatus Curse did it.

questions.question: Who is Minister for Magic while he refuses to admit Voldemort is back?
questions.note: He would rather call Dumbledore a liar than face the truth. He is forced out after the battle at the Ministry.

questions.question: Whose attack does Harry see in a vision, carried out by Nagini?
questions.note: The vision is real. It sends the Order to the Ministry and nearly gets Arthur killed.

questions.question: What is the name of the house-elf at 12 Grimmauld Place?
questions.note: He served the Black family and mutters insults at Sirius. He is devoted to the pure-blood line.

questions.question: Who does Harry kiss under the mistletoe after a D.A. meeting?
questions.note: She starts crying about Cedric in the middle of it. They do not stay together.

questions.question: What title does Umbridge hold when she first arrives to inspect the school?
questions.note: Educational Decrees let her stack power. She makes herself headmistress only after Dumbledore leaves.
